paper.title_en: Observing Massive Scattering from Null Infinity
paper.abstract_en: Because massive particles asymptote to timelike rather than null infinity, current flat space holographic proposals such as celestial or Carrollian holography struggle to describe scattering processes with massive external states. We take a step toward addressing this limitation by studying how information about massive scattering amplitudes is carried to the late-time limit of null infinity by soft graviton radiation. We show that continuity between the boundaries of timelike and null infinity implies that the late-time limit of the Bondi mass aspect naturally acts as a detector operator for massive outgoing radiation. We further relate in-in correlation functions of the Bondi mass aspect at $\mathscr{I}^+_+$ to weighted sums of scattering cross sections, implying that an observer at $\mathscr{I}$ can extract information about massive scattering processes at late times. Finally, we interpret the Bondi mass aspect as a Carrollian stress-tensor component, and study Ward identities to constrain its two-point functions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了在天球无穷远观测到的大质量散射信息的新方法，将Bondi质量方面与散射截面联系起来，并建立了Carrollian全息框架，具有理论深度和原创性。
decision.title_zh: 从零无穷远观测大质量散射
decision.abstract_zh: 因为大质量粒子渐近到类时而非类光无穷远，当前平坦时空全息方案（如天球或Carrollian全息）难以描述具有大质量外部态的散射过程。我们通过研究软引力辐射如何将大质量散射振幅的信息携带到零无穷远的晚期极限，向解决这一限制迈出了一步。我们证明了类时和类光无穷远边界之间的连续性意味着Bondi质量方面的晚期极限自然地充当了大质量出射辐射的探测器算符。我们进一步将Bondi质量方面在$\mathscr{I}^+_+$处的in-in关联函数与散射截面的加权和联系起来，这意味着$\mathscr{I}$处的观测者可以在晚期提取大质量散射过程的信息。最后，我们将Bondi质量方面解释为Carrollian应力张量分量，并研究Ward恒等式以约束其二点函数。
